# Kenshiro Remake

Become the legendary martial artist and unleash devastating techniques inspired by **Fist of the North Star**!

**Kenshiro Remake** is a modern **NeoForge 1.21.10** port/remake of the classic Kenshiro mod, redesigned for modern Minecraft.

Master powerful combat techniques, perform devastating combos, and defeat your enemies with lightning-fast martial arts.
![Kenshiro auras puch on log](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/308986a97ad6a0e1a8b89531cc2f720267bc28a0.png)<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/7sRi203K8oc" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
## Features

* 👊 Execute powerful martial arts techniques inspired by Kenshiro.
* ⌨️ All abilities are activated using configurable **Key Bindings**.
* ⚙️ Customize every key directly from Minecraft's **Controls** menu.
* 💥 Perform unique combo attacks and special techniques.
* ⚡ Modernized combat system for NeoForge 1.21.10.
* 🎮 Fully compatible with modern Minecraft controls.

## Controls

All abilities use configurable key bindings.

You can change every key at any time by opening:

**Options → Controls → Key Binds**

No special equipment, empty hands, or armor restrictions are required.

## Current Status

This remake modernizes the original gameplay while keeping the spirit of the classic mod.

Additional techniques, animations, and effects may be added in future updates.
